notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Blasting Station and Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
